selected_evidence.requirement: Streaming replication established: node1 primary, node2+node3 standbys
selected_evidence.summary: node1 initialized and started as primary with wal_level=replica; node2 and node3 base-backed up from node1 and started as standbys; pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both walreceivers streaming; both standbys show pg_is_in_recovery=t with baseline data replicated

selected_evidence.requirement: Failover: standby takes over as writable primary without losing committed data
selected_evidence.summary: Committed row 'pre-failover-committed' replicated to node2 before primary loss; node1 postgres stopped (primary lost); node2 promoted via pg_ctl promote, pg_is_in_recovery=false; node2 accepted new write 'post-failover-on-node2' while retaining all prior committed rows including the pre-failover one

selected_evidence.requirement: Other standby and recovered former primary follow the new primary
selected_evidence.summary: node3 repointed primary_conninfo to node2 and confirmed streaming from it with post-failover data; node1 rebuilt via pg_basebackup from node2, started as standby, pg_is_in_recovery=true, all data intact; node2's pg_stat_replication shows both node1 and node3 streaming

Baseline boot_id e7e1795a captured with healthy standby state; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to cb7f5583 proving restart; postgresql auto-started as standby, pg_is_in_recovery=true, all 4 ledger rows present, node2 shows node1 streaming again

Baseline boot_id cb4a7f60 captured with healthy primary state (4 rows); reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to 9437928c proving restart; postgresql auto-started as primary, pg_is_in_recovery=false, all data intact, both node1 and node3 walreceivers reconnected and streaming

Baseline boot_id ec307870 captured with healthy standby state (4 rows); reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to b42bc24f proving restart; postgresql auto-started as standby, pg_is_in_recovery=true, all data intact, node2 confirms node3 streaming again
